_approach: Dub-chord space: almost no drums at all — a single soft kick on the downbeat of each bar, a percussion 'chord stab' hit that decays across two or three echo repeats (simulating a long dub delay on a chord stab), and one open hat per bar. This is the Basic Channel-style pause: the reverb and delay tails ARE the arrangement. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
